digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler — inbound parent clear on Jira removal
propositions: A parent removed in Jira never clears the local parent_id because the fetcher omits the 'parent' key from snapshot when parent is None, leaving it indistinguishable from an unqueried state.

The inbound differ refuses to emit parent_id=None to avoid spurious clears when a Jira parent key cannot yet be resolved, collapsing three distinct states (observed-absent, unresolved, unobserved) into one None response.
The clear must be gated on positive peer evidence that Jira once had the parent, not on managed_refs alone, because managed_refs only proves local creation, not that the peer ever carried the edge.

The same-pass suppression of inbound clears against concurrent outbound writes is structurally unreachable for parent (outbound parent op only fires for epics while set_parent requires sub-tasks), making managed_refs the only active gate and enabling accidental destruction of locally-set parents.

A fail-open parent-map read (degrading to {} on REST failure or truncated page walk) must not overwrite a good peer-observation history, or the next pass interprets absence as deletion and the incident repeats.
